props.name: email
props.description: The address the email went to. Shown masked.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Send the email again. Reject to show the message.

props.name: sentOnMount
props.description: Start with the cooldown running, because an email was sent just before this screen.

props.name: onChangeEmail
props.description: Go back and use a different address. Without it, the link is hidden.

props.name: onVerifyCode
props.description: Check a typed code. Resolve false or reject to mark it wrong. Without it, only the link is offered.

props.name: expiresIn
props.description: How long the link lasts, in words — “24 hours”.

props.name: mailLinks
props.description: Shortcuts to webmail. Pass [] to hide them.

props.name: verified
props.description: Controlled verified state — for a link clicked in another tab.

props.name: verifiedAction
props.description: Shown once verified — usually a Continue button.
